summary.text: Paul Welch is the Democratic candidate for Maine House of Representatives District 85 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is a director on the Maine School Administrative District 6 (Bonny Eagle) school board, whose current term ends in 2027.

paragraphs.text: Welch writes on his campaign website that he grew up in Standish on the Saco River.

He says he has served five years as a school board director for MSAD 6, one of them as chair, and that during that time he audited classes, helped return textbooks to math classrooms and worked on school buildings.
His site also lists service as a trustee of the Standish Congregational Church and as a volunteer at the Standish Food Pantry and in lake water quality monitoring.
Welch advanced from the Democratic primary on June 9, 2026.
His site lists lowering costs for families, fair state funding for education, jobs and workforce pathways, and protecting natural resources among his priorities for Standish and Steep Falls.
